name: indirect_return
class reason: Marks `swapcontext` (ucontext.h:43, bits/indirect-return.h:30); only matters to branch-target identification, which milestone 1 does not enable (no -mbranch-protection in Ubuntu's cc1 defaults, data/facts/v-E-O0.txt).

name: nothrow
class reason: In C glibc's `__THROW` is `__attribute__ ((__nothrow__ __LEAF))` (sys/cdefs.h:77-79); it only lets the compiler assume no exception unwinds through the call. Not reached in #9 because C++ uses `noexcept`.

name: packed

name: transparent_union
class reason: `__SOCKADDR_ARG`/`__CONST_SOCKADDR_ARG` (sys/socket.h:80-84, `_GNU_SOURCE` only): a call may pass any member type, which is otherwise an incompatible-pointer-types error in GCC 14+ C.

name: __inline
class reason: A in #9. Under gnu89 glibc's `__extern_always_inline` is `extern __inline __attribute__ ((__always_inline__))` without `gnu_inline` (sys/cdefs.h:618-628, `__GNUC_GNU_INLINE__`), and <error.h> reaches such bodies at -O0 (bits/error.h). GNU89 `extern inline` must not emit an out-of-line definition; dropping `__inline` turns the body into an external definition of libc's `error`.

name: __inline__
class reason: Kernel `static __inline__` helpers (linux/swab.h); `static` functions keep their meaning when `inline` is ignored.

name: __signed__
class reason: A in #9. `__signed__` is the keyword `signed`: the kernel's `typedef __signed__ char __s8;` (asm-generic/int-ll64.h:20) needs a signed char, and plain char is unsigned on aarch64 (`__CHAR_UNSIGNED__` is predefined), so ignoring the keyword changes the type. The reasoning holds in C++ too; #9's A is corrected here.

name: bool
class reason: C23 keyword for `_Bool` (stdbit.h declarations under gnu23).

name: #warning
class reason: Diagnostic only (sys/elf.h:22); standard only from C23.

name: anonymous struct or union member
class reason: C11 feature (an extension under gnu89/gnu99): layout and member lookup.

name: enum trailing comma
class reason: C99 syntax; accepting the comma is the whole implementation.

name: enumerator value outside int
class reason: sys/epoll.h:66 (`EPOLLET = 1u << 31`) and sys/mount.h:124: pre-C23 GCC extension (C23 standard) that gives the enumerator and the enum a wider or unsigned type; values must be right.

name: long long
class reason: C99 type used in every dialect; under gnu89 an extension (`-Wlong-long`).

name: long long constant
class reason: `LL`/`ULL` suffixes (sys/ifunc.h:86, linux/swab.h); C99, an extension under gnu89.

name: qualifier in parameter array declarator ([__restrict])
class reason: C99 syntax (glibc's `__restrict_arr`, e.g. spawn.h:79); the qualifier applies to the adjusted pointer and `__restrict` may be ignored, but the declarator must parse.

name: variable-length array parameter
class reason: regex.h:686 `regexec`'s `__pmatch[__restrict_arr __nmatch]` (C99 and later); in a prototype the parameter is a pointer, so the bound may be ignored once parsed.
